input.name: image
input.letterbox: aspect-preserving fit, centered, pad rgb(114,114,114); coords map back as (u*W - dx)/scale (see train/dataset.py letterbox_params)

output.name: faces
output.channels: 0: visibility logit (sigmoid me), 1..8: x0,y0..x3,y3 normalized by input w,h
output.cornerOrder: TL,TR,BR,BL in the face's cubejs sticker-layout orientation
